map.计算叠加优惠券后的实际折扣和最终价格: Compute the effective discount and final price after stacking coupons
map.📖 查看「优惠券折扣计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Coupon Discount Calculator User Guide"
map.满减券/直减券金额: Amount of the spend-threshold or straight-reduction coupon
map.优惠券折扣是商家常用的促销手段，通过减免一定金额或提供折扣来吸引消费者购买。常见: Coupon discounts are a standard promotional tool: merchants cut a fixed amount or offer a percentage discount to attract buyers. Common forms include spend-threshold coupons, percentage coupons and no-minimum coupons.
map.：满足一定金额才能使用，如满199减50: : usable only above a minimum amount, e.g. 50 off when you spend 199
map.：按比例打折，如8折、7.5折: : a proportional discount, e.g. 20% off or 25% off
map.：多种优惠同时使用，计算实际折扣: : several offers used together, computing the effective discount
map.最终价格 = (原价 × 折扣率 - 优惠券) × 数量: Final price = (original price × discount rate - coupon) × quantity
map.注意：需先判断是否满足优惠券使用条件。: Note: first check whether the coupon conditions are met.
map.满减券叠加店铺折扣，算最终到手价与折扣力度。: Stack a spend-threshold coupon with a store discount to get the final price and the discount level.
map.核对「满多少可用」门槛是否达标。: Check whether the minimum spend for the coupon is met.
map.和相当于几折。: and what discount tier it equals.
map.原价合计 299、店铺折扣系数 1（不折）、满 200 可用 30 元券 → 最: Original total 299 with a store discount factor of 1 (no discount) and a 30 CNY coupon usable above 200 gives a final price of 269 CNY, saving 30 CNY; effective discount = 30/299 ≈ 10.0%, i.e. 269/299×10 ≈ 9.0 out of 10.
map.原价 150、满 200 才可用的 30 券 → 不触发，最终仍为 150；提示: Original price 150 with a 30 coupon that needs 200 spent means it does not trigger, so the price stays 150; the user is told to add 50 more for it to pay off.
map.实际折扣率怎么算？: How is the effective discount rate computed?
map.实际折扣率=节省金额/原价×100%，并可用 最终价/原价×10 换算成「几折」: Effective discount rate = amount saved / original price × 100%, and final price / original price × 10 converts it into a discount tier, which is more intuitive than the face value.
map.券后价能低于 0 吗？: Can the price after a coupon fall below 0?
map.工具已做保护，券后价最低为 0，不会出负数，运营配券时注意避免资不抵债。: The tool guards against it: the post-coupon price floors at 0 and never goes negative, though coupon setup should still avoid selling below cost.
